description: Ministry of Megapolis  & Western Development  - Rectification of Gazette Ex. No. 2054/45, dated 18.01.2018
reasoning: This gazette content is a rectification notice correcting a printing error in a previously published gazette notification about the City of Colombo Development Plan amendment. The core subject matter involves the Urban Development Authority Law (No. 41 of 1978) and concerns the correction of a legal/regulatory document. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments and legal notices, specifically addressing an error in a regulatory publication.
